description: AscendC codegen snapshots dumped by cannbotdsl: the macro attention kernel (float16 specialization, launch_prefix_macro.asc) and the AICPU metadata planner kernel (codegen/aicpu/, dtype-independent).

compile_case.note: T/B are dynamic Dims in the AOT spec; the snapshot is the fp16 trace of _launch_prefix_macro (kernel__PrefixMacroKernel___call___0).

notes: File layout: device kernel (namespace cannbotdsl_92, guarded by __NPU_ARCH__==3510) + host schema/invoke ABI (extern "C" entries at the tail).
bfloat16 mentions only appear in the generic runtime prelude helpers, not in the kernel body (fp16 specialization).
The AICPU snapshot keeps the 4 production files; the host-simulation variant (_x86.cpp, only compiled with build_x86=True) is not dumped.
Regeneration commands: see README.md 'codegen 快照再生成'.
